ti: TestDialHTTPMatchesStdio flakes under full-suite parallel load, three sightings

note: promoted after the fourth CI-blocking sighting; repro harness running: two concurrent full race suites per round, ten rounds, capturing the first real assertion text

Root cause captured from the failed CI attempt logs (runs/<id>/attempts/1/logs, byte-level assertion text): stdio rendered ag <agent> - 0s main, http rendered 1s — the swarm section leaked a live sub-second heartbeat age into state output, so byte-identity across transports raced the wall clock. Fix: heartbeat ages and lease countdowns render floored to whole minutes via hbAge and leaseLeft in tools.go (nine sites: ag lines, l lines, LEASE E exp=), docs/tools.md grammar updated. No liveness decision keys on sub-minute precision; sweeps bound ages to [0, agentTTL). Verification: unit tests pin the 0.9s vs 1.1s boundary that flaked; go test -race -count=10 x 2 concurrent lanes of internal/mcpclient = 20/20 green under load; bench A/B vs main baseline: tie at +0B, validity unchanged — the deliverable is determinism, not tokens. The cmd/spectackle pidfile flake sighted in the same suite run is a distinct defect, recorded as B-01KYDR with confirmed root cause

ti: tool refusals over the CLI drop the transport blurb: the refusal text is the signal, the spawn paths are noise

note: mcpclient Call now returns the ErrToolRefused marker for IsError results — the rendered text is the refusal, the transport description stays exclusively on transport errors where no result text exists; both CLI print paths (single call and stdin batch) suppress the redundant stderr re-narration for refusals, keeping the non-zero exit as the machine signal. Measured immediately: a schema refusal as a CLI agent reads it dropped from ~520 to 87 bytes, minus 83 percent. Scripted bench A/B: tie within noise, exactly as predicted — the noise lived on stderr, which the scripted driver drops and only the agent-judge stage meters; this asymmetry is why four stages exist. TestRefusalErrorCarriesNoTransportPaths pins no-paths-in-refusal-errors and ErrToolRefused; TestCallIsErrorPath unchanged green (API contract text-plus-error kept). Two fresh haiku judges are running against this build; their diets land in the archive note next to the A/B baseline of 4677 and 3846 bytes
